title: Bujh gayi pyaas chacha
body:
Bujh gayi pyaas chacha
Bujh gayi pyaas chacha laut k ghr me aao,laut k gr me aao...
Poori kar do ye dua,laut k ghr me aao..
1.Jaanti hoo ki kate aapke baazu ran mein
Aap k baad bacha kya hai mere daman mein
Kuch nahi karti gila,  x2
<<MINI>>
Laut k ghar me aao..
<<DIVIDER>>
2.Hote jaate hai bohot shaam k gehre saaye
Koi bhi ghar me nahi kaun mujhe behlaaye
Tumko deti hoon sada,   x2
<<MINI>>
Laut k ghar me aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
3.Mujhko maloom na tha door watan se aakar
Aap so jaaenge darya pe alam lehraakar
Lo chacha din bhi dhala,   x2
<<MINI>>
Laut k ghar me aao..
<<DIVIDER>>
4.Ai chacha dekhiye chinti hai phupi ki chaadar
Bhai sajjad ka khecha hai laeen ne bistar
Kya nahi tumko pata,  x2
<<MINI>>
Laut k ghr me aao..
<<DIVIDER>>
5.Maa ye kehti hai k hum qaid bhi honge ammu
Chin gayi baaliya khaaye hai tamaache ammu
Dekho daaman bhi jala,  x2
<<MINI>>
Laut k ghar me aao..
<<DIVIDER>>
6.Nanhe jhoole me kabhi godd me madar k kabhi
Dekhti hoo k mahak paaun kahi asgar ki
Saath asgar ke chacha,  x2
<<MINI>>
Laut k ghar me aao..
<<DIVIDER>>
7.Roke zainab ne kaha baali sakina meri
Be-chacha aur be-padar hona hai kismat teri
Kisko deti hai sada,   x2
<<MINI>>
Laut k ghar me aao...
<<DIVIDER>>
8.Shaam se aaj bhi zaair jo koi aata hai
Saath rehan wo paigaam yahi laata hai, Mai hoon zindaan mein chacha,    x2
<<MINI>>
Laut k ghar me aao...
